shop.name: Bike Shop
shop.footer: A Renox example: three bike stores that sell, rent and service bikes.

home.title: Bikes to buy, rent and keep riding
home.lead: Three stores, one shop: buy a bike or gear, rent one by the hour or the day, and have it serviced when it needs it.

buy.title: Buy
buy.text: Road, mountain, city and electric bikes, helmets, lights, locks and the spare parts that fit your bike.

rent.title: Rent
rent.text: Pick a bike up at any of our stores by the hour or the day, and bring it back to whichever is closest.

service.title: Service
service.text: A one-off tune-up, or a service plan whose visits are booked for you, weekly or monthly.

stores.title: Three stores, working together
stores.text: Staff help each other's stores, bikes move to where riders need them, and the stores settle up every month.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: The back office of the three stores.
dashboard.empty_text: Each store's sales, rentals, workshop and stock appear here as the example grows.

pages.title: Every page and its features
pages.lead: Each page of the bike shop, what it is for, and the Renox features that make it work. Start from a feature or from a role.
pages.none_text: No page uses that feature for that role yet.

gallery.label: Photos
gallery.keys: Photo: the arrow keys show the next one

kanban.label: Board
kanban.help: To move a card: Space or Enter picks it up, the arrow keys move it, Space or Enter drops it, Escape cancels.
kanban.cancelled: Move cancelled. :card is back in :column, position :position of :total.
kanban.failed: The move of :card couldn't be saved. It is back in :column.

datetime.order: The end must come after the start.

blocked.unavailable: That day can't be booked: pick another one.
blocked.hint: Days we can't take are greyed out on the calendar.

page.title: Bike shop blocks
page.lead: The UI pieces Renox's kit doesn't have, built inside this example as macros on the kit's tokens. Each one works here, with its signature.
page.gallery: A product's photos: arrows, thumbnails, swipes and the arrow keys, and an enlarged view in the kit's sheet.
page.form_lead: These blocks are plain form fields, so Valid<T> reads them. Send the form: the server checks every value again.
page.range: Two handles on one track, sent as two fields.
page.keypad: A counter's number pad, typing into the amount.
page.datetime: A start and an end with hours, sent as two date-times.
page.blocked: The kit's date picker with closed days.
page.swatches: Variants as chips; a change asks the server for the price and stock.
page.filter_lead: A GET form: the two handles become ?price_min=…&price_max=… in the address.
page.kanban: The workshop's jobs: drag a card, or pick it up with Space and move it with the arrow keys. Each move is sent with htmx.
page.calendar: Service visits in a month; the arrows go to the months around it.
page.availability: Bikes against the hours of a day; a free slot is a link that books it.
page.history: What happened to a bike in the workshop.
page.plans: The service plans, side by side and compared.
